headline: US Dollar Rises on Safe-Haven Demand Amid Global Tech Sell-Off
summary: The US dollar index gained 0.41% to 101.96 as a global technology sell-off fueled safe-haven demand and sterling slipped toward $1.34 ahead of the US jobs report.
why: Heightened equity market volatility frequently drives capital flows into safe-haven currencies like the US dollar.

impacts.name: US Dollar Index
impacts.why: Risk aversion and equity market drawdowns increase safe-haven demand for the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A widespread sell-off in global technology equities spurred safe-haven currency demand across international markets.
